# app/controllers/api/v1/tokens_controller.rb
class Api::V1::TokensController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token
  before_action :authenticate_api_key

  # POST /api/v1/tokens/generate
  def generate
    payload = {
      user_id: params[:user_id],
      role: params[:role] || 'viewer',
      exp: 24.hours.from_now.to_i,
      iat: Time.now.to_i
    }

    token = JWT.encode(payload, signing_key, 'HS256')
    render json: { token: token, expires_in: 86400 }
  end

  # POST /api/v1/tokens/verify
  def verify
    token = params[:token] || request.headers['X-Auth-Token']
    begin
      decoded = JWT.decode(token, signing_key, true, algorithm: 'HS256')
      render json: { valid: true, payload: decoded.first }
    rescue JWT::DecodeError => e
      render json: { valid: false, error: e.message }, status: :unauthorized
    end
  end

  # POST /api/v1/tokens/refresh
  def refresh
    old_token = params[:token]
    decoded = JWT.decode(old_token, signing_key, true, algorithm: 'HS256')
    old_payload = decoded.first

    new_payload = old_payload.merge(
      'exp' => 24.hours.from_now.to_i,
      'iat' => Time.now.to_i,
      'prev_iat' => old_payload['iat']
    )

    new_token = JWT.encode(new_payload, signing_key, 'HS256')
    render json: { token: new_token, expires_in: 86400 }
  rescue JWT::DecodeError => e
    render json: { error: e.message }, status: :unauthorized
  end

  private

  def signing_key
    # Key derived from Rails secret_key_base - reused across all token operations
    # This is the same key used for session cookies and message verifiers
    Rails.application.secret_key_base[0..31]
  end

  def authenticate_api_key
    api_key = request.headers['X-API-Key']
    unless ApiKey.active.exists?(key: api_key)
      render json: { error: 'Invalid API key' }, status: :forbidden
    end
  end
end

# config/initializers/secret_token.rb
# In production, SECRET_KEY_BASE is set via Kubernetes secret mounted at
# /etc/rails-secrets/secret_key_base
# The same secret is shared across all pods in the deployment for session affinity
Rails.application.config.secret_key_base = if File.exist?('/etc/rails-secrets/secret_key_base')
  File.read('/etc/rails-secrets/secret_key_base').strip
else
  ENV['SECRET_KEY_BASE'] || 'dev_fallback_key_not_for_production_use_abc123'
end
